name: Valery Dietrich
source:
Valery is the captain of the royal scouts and she uses her bow to strike down her enemies. She’s the sneaky type and believes that the mission is the highest priority, even if you need to bend the rules to get there. She puts on a tough facade, but deep down you can see that she truly cares about others.

[From [url=https://jubeigames.itch.io/lilithrising]Itch.io[/url]]
